settings.quadrature_validation: Both fitted objectives and their LR must agree on doubling both integration orders to absolute tolerance .001, no refitting at doubled order
settings.generating_model: Gaussian random subject offset, Beta subject/type composition, independent primer binomials sharing composition
settings.unsupported: multi-path blocks; no EC ambiguity in this synthetic control

failure_policy: All requested trials retained, nonconverged or inaccurate-quadrature fits p=1
comparison: Synthetic control only, no claim about actual-EC calibration or split/LR performance
